name: Arcmira: YouTube Transcript Search
tagline: Find quotes in YouTube videos and podcasts and jump to the timestamp.
description: Search indexed YouTube transcripts for a phrase or topic. Get the passage and a timestamped source link, or look up speaker appearances, sponsors and recommendations. [API documentation](https://arcmira.com/docs).

install.notes: Sign in to your Arcmira account with OAuth. Setup guide: https://arcmira.com/docs/mcp-server
